tracks.title: The Stardust Engine
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: As the house lights drop inside the sold-out 20,000-seat indoor arena, Cassidy's unmistakable 1986 analog synthesizer arpeggio ignites the darkness before Ryan, Evan, and Tyler slam into the band's signature cosmic arena opener.

tracks.title: Main Engine Start
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Without a second of dead air, the band transitions directly from their 1987 namesake anthem into the 142 BPM countdown thriller from 2015's *Reignition*, with 20,000 voices shouting the ten-second launch sequence in unison.

tracks.title: Hard Reset
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Completes the blistering three-song opening launch sequence by rewinding to the 1997 title anthem that inaugurated their independent Engine Room Records era.

tracks.title: Static on the Dial
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Kicks off the nocturnal highway rock block with the windows-down driving anthem from 1997's *Hard Reset*, featuring Ryan's chiming interstate guitar hook and a live shoutout to Evan and Tyler holding down the rhythm line.

tracks.title: Neon Pulse
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Green and cyan laser beams sweep across the indoor arena rafters as Cassidy's fast, arpeggiated analog sequencers and Evan's propulsive bassline drive the lead opener from 2001's *Midnight Drivers*.

tracks.title: Midnight Drivers
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: The hypnotic, rain-streaked title track of 2001's *Midnight Drivers*, featuring Cassidy's moody atmospheric synthesizer solo echoing through the cavernous indoor arena.

tracks.title: The Iceberg: Submerged
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: From 2015's *Reignition*—Cassidy's sleek 126 BPM New Wave AOR tribute to younger sister and manager Holly O'Connell, celebrating the quiet nine-tenths of the family's foundation tucked safely beneath the surface.

tracks.title: Chain Reaction
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Ignites the four-song *Apex Rebellion & Warehouse Block* with Ryan's double-solo 1989 hard-rock breakout from Side B of *Neon Hearts*.

tracks.title: Not Your Doll
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Stepping out from behind her two-tier keyboard rig to the front lip of the stage with a chrome stand mic, Cassidy unleashes her ferocious 1989 hard-rock rebellion anthem with 20,000 fans roaring the breakdown chant back to the stage.

tracks.title: Static
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Raw tube-amp guitar feedback fills the arena as Ryan tears into the lead opener from 1995's independent cassette release *The Warehouse Tapes*.

tracks.title: The Fortress
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: The fist-pumping Side A closer from 1995's *The Warehouse Tapes*, saluting the loyal fans who stood like a shield around the band when they rebuilt their sound inside their independent warehouse studio.

tracks.title: The Family
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Driven by Tyler's booming 130 BPM gated-reverb snare and Cassidy's jubilant 1980s synthesizer hook, this 1997 *Hard Reset* favorite celebrates all five members of the family—including manager Holly O'Connell—sticking together through every storm.

tracks.title: Twin Frequency: The Rhythm Section
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Ryan and Cassidy yield the center spotlights to identical twin cousins Evan and Tyler Wright for a virtuosic slap-bass and octoban drum-riser showdown from 2015's *Reignition*.

tracks.title: No Strings on the Master
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: A blistering 146 BPM hard-AOR barnburner from 2015's *Reignition* celebrating complete artistic ownership and the 1996 buyout that put every master reel permanently inside the family vault.

tracks.title: Orbital Return
tracks.discName: Disc 1: Main Engine Start — The Arena Return
tracks.loreNote: Closes Disc 1 in weightless euphoria as Cassidy's sweeping polyphonic analog pads and Ryan's volume-swell guitar solo lift the arena out of Earth's atmosphere—setting up the unbroken four-song *Twin Moons* suite at the top of Disc 2.

tracks.title: Moon 1: Tidal Lock
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: Opens Disc 2 as the indoor arena ceiling transforms into a deep-indigo starfield for Cassidy's flagship **Cosmic Tidal Lock Sound™** anthem, featuring Evan Wright's spotlight sliding fretless bass solo.

tracks.title: Moon 2: Roche Limit
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: Crimson strobes shatter the zero-gravity calm as Ryan's high-friction distorted guitar and Tyler's double-kick drums plunge the arena across the gravitational Roche limit.

tracks.title: Mayday: The Intercept
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: From 2003's *Mile Marker 98*—an urgent, galloping progressive arena-rock duet dramatizing how the family tracked the emergency beacon and pulled Ryan from the wreckage.

tracks.title: Twin Moons: Touchdown
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: Unites *Moon 1 (Sanctuary)* and *Moon 2 (Engine)* in a triumphant twin-harmony landing, concluding with the Planetarium Narrator's sign-off as Evan and Tyler step offstage for the acoustic sanctuary block.

tracks.title: Our Own Frequency
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: With Evan and Tyler taking five backstage, a single warm amber spotlight illuminates Cassidy at the acoustic grand piano and Ryan with an acoustic guitar for the title track of their intimate 2008 hiatus album.

tracks.title: Safe Person
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: Performed in pin-drop arena stillness with just grand piano, acoustic guitar, and two sibling voices—the 2008 song that gave fans around the world a name for their own anchor in the storm.

tracks.title: Still Your Safe Person
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: Unlike the stripped-down piano-and-acoustic rendition later played at *Live at the Crucible*, this arena performance captures the monumental full-band *Reignition* power-ballad build—starting with Cassidy's grand piano and Ryan's weeping clean electric guitar before Tyler's booming 78 BPM gated-reverb drum fill brings the entire electric band crashing back in.

tracks.title: Echoes in the Wire
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: Permanently holding the emotional power-ballad slot in place of the retired 1989 ballad *'If You Walked Away'*, *'Echoes in the Wire'* fills the dark indoor arena with 20,000 swaying lights and Ryan's weeping, delay-soaked guitar solo.

tracks.title: Neon on the Huckleberry Trail
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: Recorded in an out-of-state arena midway through the 2015–2016 Reignition World Tour, this performance captures the exact inverse of the legendary May 21, 2016 homecoming version on *Live at the Crucible*. Thousands of miles away from the New River Valley, 99% of the 20,000 concertgoers in the building have no idea what a "Huckleberry Train" or "Price Mountain" is. Knowing this, Ryan and Cassidy politely ask the arena to indulge them for five minutes so the five of them can play a quiet slice of home. While the main floor listens in warm, respectful stillness, the moment Ryan strikes the opening 12-string arpeggio and Cassidy mentions the six miles of asphalt from the library lawn, you can hear isolated pockets of homesick CPI alumni and Montgomery County expats up in the nosebleed sections losing their minds.

tracks.title: Neon Hearts
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: Thanking the crowd (and shouting out the twenty CPI Forgers screaming up in `Section 312`), the band kicks the final arena hit block into high gear with their reclaimed 1989 synth-rock smash.

tracks.title: My Anchor Holds
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: One of the band's most beloved 1987 *Electric Color* anthems, turning all 20,000 voices in the indoor arena into a single rafters-shaking choir.

tracks.title: Where the Stars Still Burn
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: The triumphant main-set closer of the 2015–2016 *Reignition World Tour*—looking ahead to the open horizon with twin harmonizing guitars and cascading analog synthesizer fanfare.

tracks.title: Electric Color
tracks.discName: Disc 2: The Twin Moons, Acoustic Sanctuary & A Slice of Home
tracks.loreNote: The mandatory encore closer—bringing all 20,000 fans to their feet in a joyous explosion of 1980s synth-rock and arena shred guitar.
